# Empty

What a region shows when it loaded and has nothing: why, and what to do next.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill">In Dense data</span></p>

<div class="odv-live"><span class="odv-wait">Start Storybook to see it live: <code>npm run storybook</code></span><iframe src="http://localhost:6006/iframe.html?id=components-empty--examples&viewMode=story&globals=scheme:dense-data;mode:light" title="Empty examples in Storybook" loading="lazy"></iframe><div class="bar"><span>Live from Storybook</span><a href="http://localhost:6006/?path=/docs/components-empty--docs">Open Empty in Storybook</a><a href="http://localhost:6006/iframe.html?id=components-empty--examples&viewMode=story&globals=scheme:dense-data;mode:dark">See it in dark</a></div></div>

## When to use it

**In Dense data:** An empty table says what to do next.

- **Use it when:** An empty list, a search with no results, or a first visit with no items yet.
- **Not when:** Still loading (skeleton or spinner), or a load that failed (alert).

Instead:

- [Skeleton](./skeleton.md): Still loading.
- [Alert](./alert.md): Something went wrong.

## How Dense data uses it

<div class="odv-grid two"><div class="odv-dd"><div class="stage"><div class="odv-eyebrow">An empty state</div><div style="margin-top:6px"><b style="color:var(--color-status-success)">Use</b> Why it is empty and the one action that fills it</div><div><b style="color:var(--color-status-danger)">Not</b> A blank table</div></div><div class="cap">An empty table with no words looks like an error. Example: “No escalated alerts. Change the date range to see older ones.”</div></div></div>

## Why it works this way

Empty looks the way it does because of 4 answers about this product. Each card is one answer, in three steps: the answer, what it decided for Empty, and what would move if it changed.

<section class="odv-trail" id="why-content-q1"><div class="odv-trail-head"><b>What is the main content?</b><code>content.q1</code></div><div class="odv-steps"><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>1</i>The answer</h5><div class="odv-answer">Numbers and records</div><p>Most of the screen is numbers and records.</p></div><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>2</i>So Empty</h5><ul><li><span class="n">–</span><span>does not use <b>default</b>: No pictures: an empty table needs the reason and the one action that fills it.</span></li></ul><div class="odv-also"><small>It also shapes</small> <code>Badge: neutral</code> <code>Badge: info</code> <code>Badge: success</code> <code>Badge: warning</code> <code>Badge: danger</code> <code>Sidebar: default</code> <code>Sidebar: outline</code> <code>Item: default</code> <code>Item: outline</code> <code>Toggle: default</code> <code>Toggle: outline</code></div></div><div class="odv-step-col change"><h5><i>3</i>If it changed</h5><div class="odv-big">2</div><small>Empty decisions would reopen</small><p>and 45 answers that follow from it: <b>A lot</b>, <b>Scan and compare</b>, <b>People keep their place</b>, and 42 more.</p></div></div></section>

<section class="odv-trail" id="why-voice-lands"><div class="odv-trail-head"><b>Where do the words matter most?</b><code>voice.lands</code></div><div class="odv-steps"><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>1</i>The answer</h5><div class="odv-answer">Errors and empty states</div><p>Errors and empty tables are where words decide the next action.</p></div><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>2</i>So Empty</h5><ul><li><span class="n">–</span><span>does not use <b>default</b>: No pictures: an empty table needs the reason and the one action that fills it.</span></li></ul><div class="odv-also"><small>It also shapes</small> <code>Toast: danger</code></div></div><div class="odv-step-col change"><h5><i>3</i>If it changed</h5><div class="odv-big">1</div><small>Empty decision would reopen</small><p>No other answer follows from it.</p></div></div></section>

<section class="odv-trail" id="why-iconography-roles"><div class="odv-trail-head"><b>What do icons do?</b><code>iconography.roles</code></div><div class="odv-steps"><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>1</i>The answer</h5><div class="odv-answer">Actions and status</div><p>Icons mark row actions and status.</p></div><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>2</i>So Empty</h5><ul><li><span class="y">✓</span><span>uses <b>icon</b>: An outline icon in a small tile beside the reason and the action.</span></li></ul><div class="odv-also"><small>It also shapes</small> <code>Button: icon</code> <code>Input group: inline-start</code></div></div><div class="odv-step-col change"><h5><i>3</i>If it changed</h5><div class="odv-big">1</div><small>Empty decision would reopen</small><p>No other answer follows from it.</p></div></div></section>

<section class="odv-trail" id="why-iconography-definition"><div class="odv-trail-head"><b>What icon style?</b><code>iconography.definition</code></div><div class="odv-steps"><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>1</i>The answer</h5><div class="odv-answer">Outline</div><p>Outline icons stay light next to dense text.</p></div><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>2</i>So Empty</h5><ul><li><span class="y">✓</span><span>uses <b>icon</b>: An outline icon in a small tile beside the reason and the action.</span></li></ul></div><div class="odv-step-col change"><h5><i>3</i>If it changed</h5><div class="odv-big">1</div><small>Empty decision would reopen</small><p>No other answer follows from it.</p></div></div></section>

## Words

- Lead with the object, then the state: "Alert 2041 contained."
- Use numbers, not words for numbers.
- One verb per button. No "please", no exclamation marks.
- Use: Investigate, Filter, Assign, Escalated, Resolved. Avoid: Oops, Awesome, Please, Simply.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Save
- `content.action.cancel`: Cancel
- `content.action.destroy`: Delete
- `content.action.retry`: Retry
- `content.action.empty-action`: Change filters

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add empty
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.

## Tokens it reads

Empty reads 15 tokens of its own, each an alias of a semantic token. Each row is one part: its own token, the semantic it aliases, and the value it ends at. Change a semantic and every component that reads it follows; override one of Empty's tokens to change Empty alone.
